name: code-notes
description: Understand code you did not write: notes your coding agent answers, journeys through how it works, and an understanding check before you merge.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Select code and press Ctrl+' C to leave a note.
[Add a Note](command:codeNotes.add)

Ask how something works; Claude writes a walk through the code.
[Ask a Question About the Code…](command:codeNotes.askQuestion)

editor/title/context.when: resourceScheme != code-notes-folder && resourceScheme != code-notes-note && resourceScheme != untitled

codeNotes.author.description: Your name on notes and replies. Empty: your git user.name. Messages from anyone else (e.g. an agent) show as unread until you open them.

codeNotes.folder.description: Folder (relative to the workspace folder) holding one JSON file per note. Changing it offers to move the notes. Must be a sub-folder of its own (not "." or outside the workspace).

codeNotes.ignoreInGit.description: Keep notes out of git (a .gitignore in the notes folder). Off: notes can be committed; the trash stays out of git.

codeNotes.highlight.description: Show a bar beside lines with an open note.

codeNotes.showResolvedInEditor.description: Keep resolved notes' threads in the editor (collapsed).

enumDescriptions: An "Ask Claude" button on the note box, threads and the list.
Every new note and reply goes to Claude right away.
codeNotes.claude.mode.description: Claude Code answers notes. It can read code, never change it.

codeNotes.claude.model.description: Model for answers: sonnet, opus, haiku, fable or a model id. Empty: Claude Code's default.

codeNotes.claude.path.description: Path to the `claude` CLI. Empty: found on PATH or in the usual install places.

codeNotes.claude.skills.description: Names of Claude Code skills (folders in ~/.claude/skills) that Ask Claude may use. Claude may run only those skills' own scripts; editing files and other commands stay blocked.

codeNotes.listen.readBeforeMove.description: Listening: before the code scrolls or switches files to show the next highlight, what is highlighted now stays on screen at least this many seconds (the audio waits). 0: no wait.

codeNotes.listen.settleAfterMove.description: Listening: after the code scrolled or switched files, the audio waits this many seconds with the new highlight lit, so you can find it. 0: no wait.

codeNotes.journeys.folder.description: Folder (relative to the workspace folder) holding the repository's journeys, committed and shared with the team. Journeys in the notes folder's journeys/ are read too (personal ones, the old place); with the same id, the one here wins.

codeNotes.claudeLinks.description: Code links in a Claude Code chat ("[the phrase](src/file.ts#L12-L20)") light the lines they open, with "← Back" above them to where you were.

codeNotes.journeys.codeLens.description: Outside a journey walk, one quiet line above code a journey step is about ("◇ Step 3 of Place an order"); click it to open that journey at that step.

codeNotes.journeys.authorMode.description: For journey authors: the map shows how many of the format's rules a journey breaks (the list in the Output panel).

codeNotes.journeys.model.markdownDescription: Model that writes journeys: sonnet, opus, haiku, fable or an id. Empty: `#codeNotes.claude.model#`.

codeNotes.understanding.background.markdownDescription: Writes the questions with Claude when a branch is pushed, in repositories that use the check.

codeNotes.understanding.model.markdownDescription: Model for the check: sonnet, opus, haiku, fable or an id. Empty: `#codeNotes.claude.model#`.

colors.description: Background of the journey step's lines while you walk it (a faint tint of the step bar).
Background of the code a journey's podcast is talking about now (the newest mark).
Left bar of lines with an open note.
Scrollbar mark of an open note.
Background of lines whose note is stale.
Unread marker in the Notes view and the scrollbar.
The exact text a note is about, when it was part of a line (under a dotted line).

scripts.test:integration: npm run -s build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run -a node out/test/integration/run.js

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode notes and journeys can be read and written, but Claude never runs (answering notes and steps, writing journeys): trust the folder for that.
